text:
incident-bot: Pager: high cross-region tail latency (EU->APAC). Threshold breached for 5m. Metric: cross_region_request_latency_95pct. Suspected recent traffic-weight rollout. Paging oncall.

nina (sre): Ack. I'm on it. Looks like alerts from eu-west2 -> ap-southeast1 paths. Can someone grab recent routing-change events? :eyes:

omar (netops): I see a config rollout at 1769001200 that adjusted region-weighting for eu -> ap to favor ap for low-latency. Might have flipped a flag inadvertently. Pulling audit log now.

leah (prodops): We're seeing customer reports of slow responses for users routed EU->APAC on the support queue. A couple of larger customers flagged errors/timeouts.

kevin (eng-runtime): Adding context: runtime telemetry shows increased queueing on ap pods for those specific routes. KV-cache hit rates unchanged.

nina (sre): OK. Priority: limit blast radius. Omar can you pin routing back to previous stable weights for eu->ap while we validate? We want quick rollback, not full deploy.

omar (netops): Preparing rollback. Command I'll run:
```
# rollback region weighting to 2026-02-18 stable
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/weights/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_ROBOT" \
  -d '{"scope":"eu->ap","tag":"stable-20260218"}'
```

nina (sre): If you run that, please annotate change with this thread TS.

omar (netops): Running now. Response: 202 Accepted. Change id: ch_8a3f. Rolling back weights.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: config-change ch_8a3f started at 1769004410. Auditor: omar.

kevin (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll watch ap pod queues and autoscale. If we see saturating GPUs we might need to spin reserve capacity.

carol (support): FYI support team: sending a quick update to affected customers (we'll say mitigations in progress). Want wording reviewed?

leah (prodops): Draft ok: "We're seeing elevated latency for some cross-region requests. Engineers are rolling back a recent routing weight change and monitoring. No data loss. We'll update in 15 min." :thumbsup:

nina (sre): Metrics: cross_region_request_latency_95pct trending down 2m after rollback. eu->ap error rate back to baseline. Can folks confirm service-level checks? kevin?

kevin (eng-runtime): Runtime health: 200/200 readiness, 90th and 95th pcts dropping. Autoscaling added 3 pods but drained as load normalized. No OOMs.

omar (netops): Rollback fully applied at 1769004515. Audit: previous weights restored.

incident-bot: Config-change ch_8a3f completed at 1769004515.

nina (sre): Great. Can support stop customer outbound for now? Carol?

carol (support): Stopping outbound update; will post follow-up in the ticket queue: mitigation applied, monitoring ongoing. Ask customers to report if they still see issues.

leah (prodops): Any upstream DNS TTL effects? Could some clients still be hitting old path because of DNS caching?

omar (netops): TTLs are 60s for steer records. Some cached clients could still hit old endpoints for up to ~60s. We'll monitor but rollback should be visible quickly.

nina (sre): I'll keep monitoring for 10 more minutes. If stable, we'll close incident and start RCA. Assigning follow-up owners: Omar (root cause & rollout guardrails), Kevin (runtime autoscale story), Leah (customer comms & postmortem blurb).

kevin (eng-runtime): One quick note: runtime logged increased request fanout to ap region during flip — we'll add a guard to limit concurrent fanout on newly rolled weights.

omar (netops): For RCA: looks like a CI gate didn't assert weight-increase cooldown. I'll add a canary step and a manual approval for >20% weight changes across regions.

nina (sre): Thanks all. Final check: 95pct latency normalized, error rate baseline, customer reports reducing. Marking incident mitigated at 1769004799. We'll reconvene for a 30-min async RCA doc in #eng-postmortems.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Pager resolved. Please file RCA and link this thread.
